convert_protobuf_message_to_json_string: convert a protobuf message to a JSON formatted string using MessageToJson with optional pretty-printing
convert_protobuf_message_to_dict: convert a protobuf message to a Python dictionary using MessageToDict for programmatic access
parse_json_string_to_protobuf_message: parse a JSON string into a protobuf message using Parse with an empty message prototype
parse_json_dict_to_protobuf_message: parse a JSON dictionary into a protobuf message using ParseDict with ignore_unknown_fields option
review_json_format_error_classes: review the SerializeToJsonError and ParseError exception classes for handling JSON conversion failures
